scope: strict byte-identical Run C of controlled-mutation-ui-log-replication-v2 after the preregistered Run B stop rule triggered

authorization.basis: The user explicitly requested Run C using the same four active services and the previously authorized byte-identical sample.
authorization.data_scope: exact same 8 sanitized records as Runs A and B; no new data category

routes.identity_rule: all assistant review messages Opus 5; zero fallback

routes.availability_check: agy models confirmed immediately before freeze
routes.identity_limitation: agy envelope omits runtime model identity

preregistered_analysis.primary: per-route per-mutation three-run atomic-claim detection frequency across byte-identical Runs A, B and C
secondary: per-run mutation recall and FINDING-only recall
pairwise A/B, B/C and A/C primary agreement and flips
source-verified control candidates in each run
preregistered_analysis.completion_rule: After Run C, report all three runs and stop repeated inference under this design; any further repeat or expanded sample requires a new preregistered experiment.
not_allowed: change input bytes, item order, prompt, schema, reference, routes or effort
expose reference or Runs A/B outputs to candidate models
count wording differences as detection flips
overwrite or recompute Runs A/B artifacts
interpret three runs over four mutations as a stable population ranking
